title: Sahil · South America 2026
subtitle: AI-assisted shared trip operating system
routeSummary: Argentina → Atacama → Bolivia → Rio → Paraty → Rio → Iguaçu → Rio → Cartagena → Medellín → Bogotá

days.title: London → South America
days.intro: The trip starts with one rule: travel light enough to move fast.
days.anchor: Leave London with one backpack and no unnecessary “just in case” luggage.

morning: Keep the day easy; sleep as late as practical before the overnight flight.
Final digital check: passports, insurance, cards, offline maps, reservations.
afternoon: Airport with enough buffer to avoid starting the trip stressed.
Eat before boarding rather than rely on airline timing.
evening: Overnight to Buenos Aires.
Try to sleep on destination time; hydrate aggressively.
eat: Airport meal: functional, not memorable. Save appetite for Buenos Aires.
logistics: Departure date is fixed: 20 Sep.
Target arrival EZE ~10:00 on 21 Sep.
Backpack-only is a strategic advantage throughout the solo leg.

days.decision: LOCKED DATE / flight TBD — Backpack only

days.title: Buenos Aires
days.intro: Spring Day. Art. Percussion. Tango. You land and Buenos Aires does not let you ease in.
days.anchor: La Bomba de Tiempo at Konex on Día del Estudiante / Spring Day, then a real late-night milonga.

morning: ~10:00 land EZE; use official transfer/Cabify/Uber to Palermo.
Drop bag, shower, light porteño lunch. Do not nap for three hours.
afternoon: Palermo + Bosques de Palermo while Spring Day crowds are out.
15:00-17:00 MALBA: 25th anniversary day, free admission; focus on the strongest Latin American work, then leave.
evening: 19:00 doors / 20:00 La Bomba de Tiempo at Ciudad Cultural Konex - exact-date event verified.
Late food/drink in Palermo.
Then La Viruta / milonga environment: watch, try, talk to people; no tourist tango dinner.
Home when jet lag wins, ideally ~01:30-02:00.
eat: Lunch: empanadas / milanesa / casual Palermo.
After Konex: pizza, provoleta or late porteño comfort food.
Drink: Fernet & Coke or vermouth; do not waste first night on a formal tasting menu.
logistics: Airport → Palermo ~45-70 min depending traffic.
Konex → Palermo by rideshare at night.

days.watchOut: Street-phone theft is the practical risk, not a reason to avoid the city. Keep the phone away when not using it; use rideshare between nightlife zones.
days.sleepText: Buenos Aires - Palermo. Hotel shortlist: Mine / Malevo Muraña / 1828 Smart.

days.title: Buenos Aires
days.intro: Old-money mausoleums, street-level San Telmo, Boca identity, one of the continent’s great steaks, then tango again.
days.anchor: Don Julio + a genuinely porteño night, not a sightseeing checklist.

morning: Sleep until ~09:00 after the first night.
10:00 Recoleta Cemetery (~60 min).
Quick El Ateneo / Avenida Santa Fe hit - 20 min, not a pilgrimage.
Fast historic-centre pass: Obelisco / Plaza de Mayo / Casa Rosada exterior.
afternoon: 13:00 San Telmo: eat through the market and Defensa rather than sit for 2 hours.
15:00 rideshare to La Boca; Caminito + Bombonera culture. Stay in tourist core.
17:30 back to Palermo, shower, 45-minute reset.
evening: 20:00-20:30 serious dinner: Don Julio if booked; El Preferido if not.
Cocktail or vermouth after.
Late milonga / La Viruta or an improvised next move with people you have met. Do not impose a 23:00 curfew on Buenos Aires.
eat: San Telmo: choripán / empanada / market grazing.
Dinner: Don Julio = book-now meal.
Dessert: proper Argentine helado.
logistics: Use rideshare San Telmo↔La Boca and after dark.
No football fixture worth distorting the day for on your dates.

days.watchOut: La Boca beyond the tourist core is not the place to improvise a long solo wander with your phone out.

days.title: Mendoza
days.intro: The city disappears behind you; by sunset you are on horseback under the Andes eating asado by a fire.
days.anchor: Sunset cabalgata + asado + Malbec - the first big landscape pivot of the trip.

morning: Early AEP→MDZ nonstop. Target 08:00-09:30; exact flight to reconfirm before booking.
Hotel bag drop and light lunch.
afternoon: No plaza-ticking. Transfer to the foothills / ranch.
Winter schedule for the current Vempra ride lists ~14:30 departure, 2 hours on horseback and dinner included.
evening: Ride to the viewpoint as the light drops over the Andes.
Asado, wine, dessert and fire-side sobremesa; some departures include guitar.
Return to Mendoza; one drink only if the group continues.
eat: Lunch: light empanadas mendocinas.
Dinner is part of the horseback experience: asado + wine.
logistics: AEP, not EZE, for the domestic hop.
Sunset ride currently shows free cancellation to 72h and Sep 2026 inventory calendar.

days.watchOut: You do not need riding expertise, but tell the operator your level. Dress for a cold post-sunset return.
days.sleepText: Mendoza - Casa Lila / Diplomatic / Park Hyatt.
days.decision: TARGET / RECONFIRM — Earliest useful AEP flight

days.title: Mendoza
days.intro: Today is not “visit wineries.” Today is the Andes expressed through wine.
days.anchor: Valle de Uco + a long lunch at Zuccardi / Piedra Infinita.

morning: Small-group/private-small transfer to Valle de Uco.
One excellent producer in the morning, not three rushed tastings.
afternoon: Zuccardi: architecture, cellar, terroir-focused tasting.
Long Piedra Infinita lunch with Andes view. Wine is the event; do not schedule a fourth winery.
evening: Simple neighbourhood evening: Fuente y Fonda / local wine bar, no elaborate second tasting menu.
eat: Breakfast: bakery/café.
Lunch: Piedra Infinita - flagship food experience.
Dinner: home-style Argentine food, modest portions after a wine day.
logistics: Use a small-group/private-small vehicle; avoid a 40-person coach.
Reserve winery + lunch well ahead.

days.watchOut: If you drank heavily at lunch, the correct evening is water + food + sleep, not proving you can continue drinking.

days.title: Mendoza → Atacama
days.intro: Skip Santiago completely and make the Andes-to-desert jump in one travel day.
days.anchor: Mendoza → Calama the same day, then straight to San Pedro de Atacama.

morning: Leave Mendoza for Calama (CJC) on the best same-day routing. One air connection is acceptable; Santiago is transit only, not a stop.
Keep the 40L backpack in cabin and avoid a checked-bag connection.
afternoon: Continue to Calama, then take a shared airport transfer to San Pedro de Atacama.
Check in, hydrate and keep the first hours gentle at altitude.
evening: First San Pedro wander, simple Andean dinner and an early night.
Do not stack a major excursion onto the travel day.
eat: Travel-day food should be practical; save the better San Pedro meals for the next two nights.
logistics: Search MDZ → CJC as one same-day journey; a connection is fine, but there is no Santiago overnight.
Shared CJC → San Pedro transfer is the default on arrival.

days.watchOut: Do not book separate tickets with an unsafe connection buffer. Protect the Calama arrival and onward transfer.
days.sleepText: San Pedro de Atacama - first of three nights.
days.decision: TARGET / RECONFIRM — MDZ → CJC same day; Santiago removed

days.title: San Pedro De Atacama
days.intro: A full first desert day: acclimatise in San Pedro, then let the full moon become part of the landscape rather than fighting it.
days.anchor: Valle de la Luna sunset + indigenous full-moon astronomy.

morning: Slow breakfast, hydrate and acclimatise in town.
Easy San Pedro orientation: adobe streets, market/cafés and a short low-altitude wander rather than a punishing high-altitude excursion.
afternoon: Valle de la Luna late afternoon; salt formations and desert sunset.
Keep the first full day around San Pedro altitude rather than immediately forcing 4,500m.
evening: Dinner in town.
Alarkapin-style full-moon / Andean astronomy experience: Moon, bright planets/objects and indigenous sky interpretation.
eat: Lunch: La Picada del Indio or similar local meal.
Dinner: Adobe / a good small Andean kitchen; try llama, quinoa or rica-rica.
logistics: You are already in San Pedro from the night before.
26 Sep is full moon; use that deliberately rather than buying a misleading Milky Way tour.

days.watchOut: Hydrate. Go easy on alcohol. You are about to spend several days above 4,000m.
days.sleepText: San Pedro de Atacama - second night.
days.decision: TARGET / RECONFIRM — Then shared transfer to San Pedro

days.title: San Pedro De Atacama
days.intro: Earn the desert instead of watching it through a minibus window.
days.anchor: Mountain-bike ride through Pukará de Quitor / Catarpe terrain, then a social San Pedro afternoon.

morning: Rent a good mountain bike / helmet after breakfast.
Ride towards Pukará de Quitor and Catarpe / canyon sectors, subject to current access.
afternoon: Return early afternoon. Big lunch, shower, rest.
Wander adobe streets, market, café/bar; meet other travellers heading into Bolivia.
evening: Early dinner.
Pack layers, water and essentials for the 4x4 crossing.
No premium “Milky Way” tour - moon still dominates the sky.
eat: Breakfast: proper carbs + water.
Lunch: hearty local menu.
Dinner: early, simple, social.
logistics: Reconfirm route access locally the day before; desert tracks can close/change.
Keep passport/cash accessible for border next morning.

days.watchOut: If altitude symptoms are significant, skip the bike and rest. Bolivia is not the place to arrive depleted.

days.title: Bolivian Altiplano
days.intro: The road effectively ends and the 4x4 becomes your world.
days.anchor: Border crossing into Bolivia, high-altitude lagoons, Dalí Desert, hot springs and Laguna Colorada in one raw day.

morning: Very early departure San Pedro. Chile exit / Bolivia entry at Hito Cajón.
Transfer into expedition 4x4 with your small group.
afternoon: Laguna Blanca / Verde, surreal desert, geothermal landscapes.
Get into the Polques hot springs rather than just photograph them.
Laguna Colorada and flamingos.
evening: Remote lodge dinner with the 4x4 group.
Cards, wine/tea, conversation; embrace the basicness.
eat: Tour food is included. Carry snacks you actually want to eat.
Coca tea can help with comfort but does not “cure” altitude sickness.
logistics: Book a reputable operator with oxygen and clear vehicle/safety standards.
Remote lodge quality varies - that is part of this section, not a hotel failure.

days.watchOut: Altitude can exceed 4,500m. Severe headache, vomiting, confusion, breathlessness at rest = descend / seek medical help; do not “push through.”
days.sleepText: Remote Bolivian Altiplano lodge - included with expedition.

days.title: Bolivian Altiplano
days.intro: A day that looks like another planet for hours at a time.
days.anchor: Rock valleys, high lagoons, vicuñas, tiny settlements and the social micro-world of your 4x4 group.

morning: Simple lodge breakfast.
Continue across the high desert. Exact stops depend on operator/route conditions.
afternoon: Valleys of rock, high-altitude wetlands, flamingo lagoons / canyon stops as routing allows.
Do not obsess over mobile signal; this is the point.
evening: Arrive salt hostel / remote lodge near Salar.
Group dinner; early night ahead of the Salar.
eat: Included meals.
Try local quinoa / llama when served, but expedition food is primarily fuel.
logistics: No independent route-planning needed once operator is selected.
Keep batteries warm at night; cold drains them quickly.

days.watchOut: This is intentionally one of the least luxurious nights of the trip.
days.sleepText: Salt hostel / remote lodge - included with expedition.

days.title: Salar De Uyuni
days.intro: White infinity by day; real dark sky before the Moon rises at night.
days.anchor: Salar de Uyuni + a protected moon-free stargazing window before ~22:44 moonrise.

morning: Early start onto Salar. Sunrise/first light, salt polygons, Isla Incahuasi if route/conditions allow.
Perspective photos: do them; they are silly and genuinely fun here.
afternoon: Finish expedition in Uyuni ~14:00-15:00.
Hotel, hot shower, food, two-hour reset.
evening: Return to Salar for sunset.
Astronomical darkness begins after ~19:38; moonrise ~22:44 on 30 Sep. Protect ~19:45-22:15 for true dark-sky viewing / telescope / astrophotography.
Back to town before/around moonrise.
eat: Early dinner before the night tour or substantial late lunch.
Keep alcohol low: stars + altitude + early flight next day.
logistics: The Uyuni dark-sky window is date-specific and verified from lunar data.
Book a stargazing operator who can explicitly work within the pre-moonrise window.

days.watchOut: September is dry season: do not expect the mirror-water effect. The reward is huge dark sky and the stark salt surface.
days.sleepText: Uyuni - Casa de Sal / Cristales Joyas de Sal / Jardines de Uyuni.

days.title: La Paz
days.intro: You land in a city built in a canyon and then ride above it before watching cholitas wrestle at altitude.
days.anchor: Mi Teleférico + El Alto / cholet context + Thursday Cholita Wrestling.

morning: BoA OB303 UYU→LPB 10:05-~11:05 - schedule verified.
Hotel in Calacoto / Zona Sur; light lunch / salteña.
afternoon: Use Mi Teleférico as the city tour: ride from the lower city towards El Alto, understanding the geography from above.
Look at cholet architecture / El Alto context with a reputable guide or organised route.
evening: Thursday = ideal Cholita Wrestling night. Use organised transport/guide; do not improvise solo transport after dark in El Alto.
Late dinner or drink back in Zona Sur.
eat: Must eat: salteña, api if found, anticucho if comfortable with street food.
Dinner option: Arami / Gustu if timing works, but wrestling has priority.
logistics: Stay in Zona Sur rather than chasing a cheaper central room.
Ride teleférico in daylight; organised transport for wrestling.

days.watchOut: La Paz altitude is ~3,650m and El Alto higher. Take the first hours slowly.
days.sleepText: La Paz - Atix / MET / Casa Grande.

days.title: La Paz · Day 2
days.intro: A second La Paz day lets the city breathe instead of treating it as a one-night altitude stop.
days.anchor: Historic La Paz at street level, then the canyon geography from above.

morning: Slow start after the previous night: Plaza Murillo / historic centre, Mercado de las Brujas and Mercado Lanza at street level.
Stop for salteñas and coffee rather than turning the morning into a museum checklist.
afternoon: Use Mi Teleférico again for the city-scale views, then head to Valle de la Luna / Zona Sur if energy and weather are good.
Keep the day flexible at altitude; the point is texture, not box-ticking.
evening: Make this the refined Bolivian dinner night: Gustu / Arami if the reservation works.
One drink afterwards in Zona Sur if you feel good; no need to manufacture nightlife.
eat: Salteña, api, anticucho if comfortable with street food, then one serious modern-Bolivian dinner.
logistics: Second La Paz night. Pack for an early/efficient flight to Rio the next day.
Stay in Calacoto / Zona Sur for clean airport and evening logistics.

days.watchOut: La Paz is ~3,650m. Even after the Altiplano, hydrate and do not turn a good day into an altitude test.

days.title: Rio De Janeiro
days.intro: The group converges in Rio on the same day: Sahil drops from La Paz to sea level while Niki, Priyesh and Amisha arrive from London and Dubai.
days.anchor: Everyone’s first shared Brazil memory is Rio - beach, sunset and a real welcome dinner.

morning: Sahil: fly La Paz → Rio on the shortest sensible routing, ideally via Santa Cruz with cabin baggage only.
Niki / Priyesh / Amisha travel toward Rio on their booked or selected long-haul routings.
afternoon: Sahil arrives GIG and transfers to Ipanema/Arpoador/Leblon; shower, laundry and reset from the Altiplano.
Priyesh & Amisha target Emirates EK247 DXB→GIG; Niki arrives directly from London. Build real airport buffers.
evening: Once all four are in: Arpoador / Ipanema for first drinks and beach energy.
Polished Brazilian welcome dinner, then music only if everyone still has energy.
eat: Pão de queijo / pastel / mate / caipirinha.
Dinner should feel Brazilian, not generic hotel luxury.
logistics: Do not pre-book an early-evening non-refundable event; three separate arrival streams are converging.
Two rooms from tonight.

days.sleepText: Rio - same hotel; all four together.
days.decision: TARGET / RECONFIRM — Niki joins directly in Rio

days.title: Rio De Janeiro
days.intro: The city’s impossible geography in one full sweep.
days.anchor: Christ early + Santa Teresa + Sugarloaf through golden hour.

morning: Early Corcovado / Christ by official transport before peak crowds.
Compact Santa Teresa / Selarón pass afterwards.
afternoon: Long carioca lunch, then 2-3 hours of beach/reset.
This is not dead time; it is part of Rio.
evening: Sugarloaf timed for late afternoon → sunset → city lights.
Casual dinner; no tasting menu tonight.
eat: Brazilian classics at lunch; boteco food at night.
logistics: Pre-book Christ and Sugarloaf timed entries.
Keep valuables minimal on mixed sightseeing/beach days.

days.title: Rio De Janeiro
days.intro: Use the day lightly so Monday night can be the cultural anchor.
days.anchor: Pedra do Sal Monday roda de samba in Little Africa.

morning: Beach / slow breakfast. If flying conditions are excellent, hang-glide can move here as a weather flex.
afternoon: Guided Little Africa / Valongo context before the music, or move the history walk to Tuesday if the day is too full.
Rest before night.
evening: Boteco bite, then Pedra do Sal Monday samba.
Go for music and atmosphere, not valuables.
eat: Cold chopp, bolinho, simple carioca food.
logistics: Rideshare to/from Little Africa at night.
Keep Tuesday as weather backup for hang-gliding.

days.watchOut: Phone and jewellery discreet at Pedra do Sal and in dense crowds.

days.title: Rio → Paraty
days.intro: Final Rio morning, then the Costa Verde road to Paraty for two nights.
days.anchor: Private road transfer to Paraty; historic centre in the evening.

morning: Easy final Rio morning.
afternoon: Private road transfer Rio → Paraty.
evening: Paraty Historic Centre, dinner and cachaça.
eat: Dinner in/near the historic centre.
logistics: Paraty nights: 6 and 7 Oct.

days.watchOut: Allow 4–5 hours and Rio traffic buffer.

days.title: Paraty · Mamanguá
days.intro: Full Paraty day: fjord-like water, jungle and swim stops.
days.anchor: Saco do Mamanguá boat day, flexed around weather and energy.

morning: Early boat toward Saco do Mamanguá.
afternoon: Swim / beach / optional Pico hike; return before dark.
evening: Second Paraty evening and dinner.
eat: Local caiçara food with non-seafood alternatives.
logistics: Keep the boat operator flexible for weather.

days.watchOut: Flex the boat plan for sea/weather.

days.title: Paraty → Rio
days.intro: Slow Paraty morning, then back to Rio for one reset night.
days.anchor: Private road transfer Paraty → Rio.

morning: Breakfast and final Paraty wander.
afternoon: Private road transfer Paraty → Rio.
evening: Easy Rio sunset and dinner.
eat: Dinner around Ipanema/Leblon.
logistics: Rio reset night between Paraty and Iguaçu.

days.watchOut: Keep the evening flexible for road traffic.

days.title: Rio → Iguaçu · Argentina side
days.intro: Fly early from Rio and spend the day on the Argentine side of the falls.
days.anchor: Early GIG → IGU, then the Argentine circuits; sleep in Foz.

morning: Early nonstop GIG → IGU; transfer to the Argentine side.
afternoon: Argentine falls circuits and Devil’s Throat access if operating.
evening: Return to Foz, easy dinner and early night.
eat: Simple dinner in Foz.
logistics: One Foz night only: 9 Oct.
Carry passports for the border crossing.

days.watchOut: Protect the early flight and border-transfer time.
days.sleepText: Foz do Iguaçu - one night, 9 Oct.

days.title: Iguaçu → Rio
days.intro: Brazilian side in the morning, optional Macuco, then back to Rio for Saturday night.
days.anchor: Brazilian falls + optional Macuco; target the ~18:15 IGU → GIG flight.

morning: Brazilian falls circuit.
Macuco Safari if wanted and timings work.
afternoon: Head to IGU with buffer; target ~18:15 IGU → GIG.
evening: Land Rio and enjoy the final Saturday night together.
eat: Final Rio dinner depending on arrival time.
logistics: Sleep Rio so 11 Oct is an easy departure day.

days.watchOut: Do not compromise the Brazilian side, but avoid the last flight of the night.

days.title: Rio → London / Cartagena
days.intro: Easy Rio morning, then all four head to GIG together: Niki to London; Sahil, Priyesh and Amisha to Bogotá and onward Cartagena.
days.anchor: Niki: BA248 GIG → London ~16:45. Trio: AV146 GIG → Bogotá ~16:40, then onward Cartagena.

morning: Easy Rio breakfast / lunch and final packing.
afternoon: All four head to GIG together.
Niki: BA248 to London (~16:45).
Sahil + Priyesh + Amisha: AV146 to Bogotá (~16:40).
evening: Trio connect Bogotá → Cartagena the same evening; exact onward flight to confirm.
eat: Keep food functional around airport timings.
logistics: Niki leaves the trip in Rio on 11 Oct.
Cartagena nights remain 11, 12 and 13 Oct.

days.watchOut: This is a split-traveller day. The app must never assume Niki continues to Colombia.
days.sleepText: Cartagena - night 1 of 3 for Sahil, Priyesh and Amisha.

days.title: Cartagena
days.intro: Wake up in the Caribbean instead of spending the holiday cycling Bogotá.
days.anchor: Walls / old city at human pace → pool reset → Getsemaní after dark.

morning: Sleep after the 02:00 arrival; do not force a 07:00 start.
Late breakfast and a compact old-city / walls walk before heat peaks.
afternoon: Pool / air-conditioning reset.
Late-afternoon Getsemaní murals, street life and music.
evening: Plaza de la Trinidad / Getsemaní energy.
Street food, rum, live music; keep Celele for tomorrow.
eat: Arepa de huevo, tropical fruit, coconut rice, limonada de coco.
logistics: The old Bogotá full day is gone. This is the payoff: a true first Cartagena day.

days.title: Cartagena
days.intro: Market floor to one of Latin America’s best restaurants to live salsa.
days.anchor: Bazurto Market with a guide → Celele → salsa.

morning: Guided Bazurto food/culture visit - do not do Bazurto independently.
Eat through the market rather than treating it as a photo stop.
afternoon: Hotel pool / air conditioning 14:00-16:30. This is strategic.
Late Getsemaní / walls if wanted.
evening: Dinner: Celele - reserve.
After: live salsa (Café Havana or best current programme).
eat: Market fruit / snacks at lunch; Celele is the flagship dinner.
logistics: Use a vetted local guide for Bazurto.

days.watchOut: Midday heat is punishing; protect the reset block so the night stays good.

days.title: Cartagena → Medellín
days.intro: One last Caribbean half-day, then Colombia changes climate and rhythm by dinner.
days.anchor: Final Cartagena morning + Medellín arrival + local salsa night.

morning: Slow breakfast. Castillo San Felipe early if you want the historic anchor; otherwise enjoy the old city.
afternoon: Local lunch, pool/shower, airport.
Target direct CTG→MDE around 17:25; exact flight to reconfirm.
evening: Check in. Son Havana / Laureles-style salsa environment.
Join a class if it runs; bottle-service Poblado is not the objective.
logistics: MDE airport is outside the city; allow transfer time.

days.title: Guatapé day trip / Medellín
days.intro: A big landscape day out of Medellín, but Medellín remains the base.
days.anchor: Piedra del Peñol + Guatapé + reservoir, then back to Medellín for the night.

morning: Leave early. Climb Piedra del Peñol before peak crowds.
afternoon: Boat on reservoir. Antioquian lunch. Walk Guatapé zócalos / colourful streets.
evening: Return Medellín. If salsa clicked, go deeper; otherwise switch to contemporary music/bar energy.
eat: Bandeja paisa / grilled Antioquian food; aguardiente in moderation.
logistics: Day trip from Medellín; do not move hotels.
Return to Medellín for the second and final night.

days.title: Medellín → Bogotá
days.intro: Use almost the full Medellín day, then fly to Bogotá for the final night.
days.anchor: Medellín daytime → evening flight → Bogotá final night.

morning: Metro / Metrocable as core experience.
Coffee at a strong local roaster.
afternoon: Community-led neighbourhood / urban-transformation tour. Choose provider carefully.
Proper Antioquian lunch.
evening: Fly Medellín → Bogotá.
Check in around Chapinero / Zona G; simple late dinner or drink depending arrival.
logistics: One Bogotá night only: 16 Oct.
Protect enough airport buffer without sacrificing the Medellín day.

days.watchOut: If a neighbourhood tour feels extractive or voyeuristic, skip it.

days.title: Bogotá → onward / home
days.intro: One last Bogotá hit, then the South America trip ends at the airport.
days.anchor: Early Monserrate / compact Bogotá finish, final lunch, then fly out on the 17th.

morning: Early Monserrate for the city-and-mountain view.
Descend for a compact Candelaria / specialty-coffee hit if queues and traffic cooperate.
afternoon: Final lunch: ajiaco or contemporary Colombian close to the route; no long tasting menu.
Return hotel, bags. Priyesh & Amisha leave for BOG ~14:00 for 17:15 flight.
evening: Airport and outbound flights.
logistics: All remaining travellers leave Bogotá on 17 Oct.
Exact outbound flight details should be attached once confirmed.

days.watchOut: Do not schedule Monserrate late. The point is a concentrated taste, not squeezing in a full Bogotá itinerary.
days.sleepText: Fly out of Bogotá on 17 Oct.

rules.title: Safety without paranoia
rules.text: Micro-location matters more than saving a small amount. Use rideshare at night in Rio, Cartagena, Medellín and Bogotá. Keep phone/jewellery discreet in crowded nightlife and beach areas. Use vetted guides for Bazurto and community-led Medellín visits.

rules.title: Altitude
rules.text: San Pedro ~2,400m; La Paz ~3,650m; the Altiplano routinely exceeds 4,000m. Hydrate, eat, reduce alcohol and do not push through severe altitude symptoms.

rules.title: Moon / stars
rules.text: Full moon 26 Sep. San Pedro = lunar/Andean astronomy. Uyuni 30 Sep = protected dark-sky window before ~22:44 moonrise.

rules.title: Spontaneity
rules.text: Reserve scarce/high-value experiences; keep ordinary meals and second drinks loose. Extra Rio nights deliberately create weather flexibility.

rules.title: Connection discipline
rules.text: Treat 11 Oct AV146 → Bogotá → Cartagena clinically: hand luggage where possible, realistic connection buffer, online check-in, pre-arranged Cartagena transfer, hotel booked from 11 Oct, and live recheck before payment.

criticalAlert: 11 Oct: group split in Rio — Niki flies BA248 to London; Sahil, Priyesh and Amisha take AV146 to Bogotá, then connect onward to Cartagena.
